subject: Renewal: Elara Health — capacity increase & MSA Exhibit E carveouts
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Elara Health — capacity increase & MSA Exhibit E carveouts

Team —

Elara just confirmed their intent to renew for 24 months with a ~2.5x capacity uplift (baseline to 1.2M tokens/month). They have two asks that will land in the paperwork: a term restructure (24 months instead of 12) and an Exhibit E carveout that narrows SLA remedies for a subset of production routes (their clinical inference cluster).

Attached is the latest order form (v3) and a zip of the notes from yesterday's call. Key points I need legal's read on:
- Whether we can accept a limited SLA carveout scoped to the clinical cluster without exposing platform-wide SLA risk.
- How to express the carveout in Exhibit E so it's operational (specific routes, model names, region) and timeboxed (12 months trial).
- Any concerns on data residency requirement they raised — they want EU residency for logs related to clinical inference (they're US-based but subject to EU patient data onward transfers).

Karthik — will need you to confirm price/discount math (they expect annual invoicing). Grace — heads up for renewal playbook and onboarding for the extra capacity.

Next step: Marissa, could you return a redline of Exhibit E + a short note on fallback language by EOD Wed? I want to be able to send a balanced counter to Maxine by Thursday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Maxine Turner <maxine.turner@elarahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Elara Health — capacity increase & MSA Exhibit E carveouts

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick follow. We do intend to move forward if we can get two items in place:
1) A guaranteed 24-month term with pricing locked (our board wants predictability).
2) Exhibit E carveout that limits full SLA remedies for the clinical-inference cluster only — we will accept a 6-month partial remediation window while we validate model behavior in prod. We are open to an operational definition (list of routes + region).

On data residency: we can accept US-based serving for inference, but logs and audit trails for clinical routes must remain in EU (we use a regional logging partner).

We'll review your counter. Attached is our procurement checklist (pdf).

Best,
Maxine
Head of Procurement, Elara Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Elara Health — capacity increase & MSA Exhibit E carveouts

Jonas —

Attached is a redline of Exhibit E (MSA_ExhibitE_redline_20260622.pdf). High-level legal POV:
- We can accept a scoped SLA carveout limited to specific routes and a single region, but recommend the following guardrails:
  • Timebox the carveout to an explicit trial period (we propose 6 months with options to extend by mutual written agreement).
  • Require Elara to enumerate routes and model identifiers in Schedule A (operational attachment) — avoid vague language like "clinical routes".
  • Limit financial remedies for the carveout to credits capped at 25% of the monthly invoice for affected routes; full platform SLA remains in force for non-listed routes.
- For data residency: we cannot wholesale accept logs-on-EU-only without confirming how cross-border access requests from Redwood will be handled. Suggest: allow EU storage for audit logs related to the listed routes, with a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) amendment and the customer's KMS for those logs.
- Fallbacks: include an automatic failover clause — if regional logging fails, both parties agree to a documented recovery plan with notification timelines.

I'll mark up precise language for Schedule A and the credit cap. Also flagged two legal terms for escalation: 'indemnity carveouts' and 'termination for convenience' conditioning.

I'll aim to send the redline + a 1-page negotiation playbook for sales by EOD Wednesday.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maxine Turner <maxine.turner@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Elara Health — capacity increase & MSA Exhibit E carveouts

Maxine / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clarity. Marissa has reviewed and attached our proposed Exhibit E redline. Summary of our counter-proposal:
- 24-month term locked at the quoted rates in Elara_OrderForm_v3.docx.
- Exhibit E scope must list routes (we propose routes: /v1/infer/clinical-v2, /v1/infer/clinical-qa) and region eu-west-1 for log retention.
- Carveout window: 6 months trial; remedies capped as Marissa described (25% monthly cap for affected routes).
- Data residency: we will accept EU storage for audit logs with a DPA amendment and access via Redwood request pipeline; customer-managed KMS is acceptable subject to SOC2 attestation.

Action items:
- Maxine: confirm the two routes above cover your clinical cluster or provide the canonical route names by EOD Thursday.
- Karthik: confirm annual invoicing cadence and updated payment schedule to insert into the order form.
- Marissa: please add fallback language for logging failover and an escalation path if we can't meet EU-residency constraints.

I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope once we have route confirmation.

Best,
Jonas

From: Maxine Turner <maxine.turner@elarahealth.com>

Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com

Jonas —

Confirmed: the two routes you listed are the canonical endpoints for the clinical workload. We accept the 6-month trial and the 25% remedy cap for those routes. For the DPA: Elara legal will send the DPA template; we expect Redwood to insert the KMS binding language.

One ask: can billing be annual in advance? We prefer net-45 invoicing on an annual pre-pay schedule if possible.

If you can update the order form with annual pre-pay and send the DocuSign link, we can aim to sign next week.

Thanks,
Maxine
